cells: REGIONAL DEX — GROWTH & EVOLUTION INTEGRATION v4
All 187 species use the current exact base-stat/type data from Regional_Dex_Stats_and_Abilities_COMPLETE_v2.xlsx.
Six formula-driven growth percentages are integrated for HP, Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed.
Growth above 100% is preserved and represents exceptional growth; HP gains +10 per successful HP growth roll.
All 98 existing evolution thresholds/minimums are retained after simulation: every target form has a higher expected total growth budget than its source form.
Delaying an available evolution therefore permanently gives up expected stat growth; the Level 200 cap is not a reason to double evolution thresholds.
Where older progression typing conflicts with the current complete Dex, the complete Dex type is authoritative.
This is a consolidated derivative workbook; the File Library source workbooks were not overwritten in place.
MAX(10, ROUND(Mean Growth × (Base Stat ÷ Mean Stat)^2.25))
100%+ guarantees the first increment; excess percentage is the chance of a second increment.
HP gained per successful HP growth
Normal stat gained per successful growth
Each level makes six independent growth rolls.
HP success = +10 HP; exceptional second HP success makes +20 HP total for that level.
Other stat success = +1; exceptional second success gives +2 total.
Failed rolls add nothing. Zero-success and six-success level-ups are legal.
Each individual has an immutable deterministic Growth Seed.
Reloading or action order cannot reroll growth history.
Evolution adds fixed target-minus-source base-stat deltas once, then immediately uses evolved growth rates.
Higher-level generated monsters simulate all prior growth from their fixed seed.
